# The Gnostic Religion

*[Hans Jonas](../philosophers/jonas.md) · 1958 · *The Gnostic Religion**

A synthesis, published in English, of the research [Jonas](../philosophers/jonas.md) had pursued since his dissertation, whose first fruit was Gnosis und spätantiker Geist (1934). He reads ancient Gnosticism with the tools of existential analysis, and relates its dualism to modern nihilism.
